detected_fault: Thermal Throttling and intermittent shutdowns when using integrated graphics
suggested_solution: Perform a thorough cleaning of the laptop's internal components
Inspect thermal paste and replace if necessary
Check battery health and ensure it is within normal parameters
Install a fresh copy of Windows without Armoury Crate
Utilize software like NZXT Cam to monitor temperatures and identify any potential issues
Run benchmarks to determine the system's performance under load
